tables.title: RDES2 normal descriptor (read format)
tables.text: Table 553, "RDES2 normal descriptor (read format)", in section 48.10.4 (Receive descriptor) on page 2269. Columns: Bit, Name, Description. 1 data row(s).

rows:
Buffer 2 Address Pointer
These bits indicate Buffer 2 physical address.
The RxDMA uses the LS bits of the pointer address only while transferring the 
start bytes of a packet. If the BUF2AP is giving the address of a buffer in which 
the middle or last part of a packet is stored, the DMA ignores RDES2[1:0]=0 
and writes to the complete location.
